_about: The known debt of the UI checks (scripts/ci/ui-checks.mjs), written down once. Every entry is a COUNT of offences per rule and file, with the reason and the slice that owes the fix. The count is a ratchet: one more offence than listed fails the check, and one fewer fails it too (lower the count), so the list only shrinks and an entry cannot outlive its cause. A file entry is a number, or {count, reason} when that file has a reason of its own. A rule with no entry here has no debt. node scripts/ci/ui-checks.mjs --counts prints the current numbers.

colour-built-at-runtime.reason: the impact meter ramp interpolates its stop colours at run time; it moves to color-mix on the band tokens (K:52, K:53).

class-undefined.reason: a string that starts with cl- and is not a class: a localStorage key, an element id, or a test-mount wrapper class that carries no style. The rule reads every cl- string; these stay and say so.

bare-fetch.reason: a fetch( call outside the one request caller (C:55, K:93).

src/core/http/request-json.ts.reason: this is the one request caller: every other module calls it.

src/core/turn/wiring.ts.reason: the production default of the injected fetch implementation (opts.fetchImpl ?? fetch); the turn hands the gated primitive everything else.

src/features/auth/ui/AuthProvider.tsx.reason: the identity loader reads the Retry-After header of the response to decide how long to wait; the one request caller does not yet hand a refusal its headers.

src/features/coverage/client.tsx.reason: the CSV export reads the response as a file (the text of the body and its content-disposition header), which the JSON request caller does not carry.

src/ui/shell/GlobalErrorReporter.tsx.reason: the error reporter must not depend on the request caller whose failure it may be reporting; it posts with keepalive.

entity-in-string.reason: an HTML entity in a string.

src/features/regulations/map/MapView.tsx.reason: Leaflet reads its attribution option as HTML, so the entity is decoded there: it stays.
